items.quote: And this shall be an everlasting statute unto you, to make an atonement for the children of Israel for all their sins once a year.
items.claim: The text sets up a permanent ('everlasting') statute requiring atonement for all the sins of the children of Israel once a year.
items.object: annual atonement for the children of Israel
items.mechanism: a ritual of atonement done once a year covering all their sins

items.quote: And he did as the LORD commanded Moses.
items.claim: The text says the command was carried out as the LORD had told Moses. The document does not name who 'he' is. Reading 'he' as Aaron comes from the surrounding chapter and is only an unverified model-prior.
items.actor: he (not named in the document; Aaron per unverified model-prior)
items.mechanism: following the command given through Moses
